newsitem.title: USA: NMC buying Canal Jean for $22 million.
newsitem.headline: NMC buying Canal Jean for $22 million.

text.p: NMC Corp. said Monday it plans to buy Canal Jean Co. Inc., a clothing store in New York City's Soho district, for about $22 million worth of stock.
NMC said it will offer 5 million shares of its common stock for Canal Jean, which will operate as a wholly-owned subsidiary.
NMC's stock rose 37.5 cents to $4.375 on the Nasdaq bulletin board.
NMC, based in New York, said Canal Jean plans to create a private label, license its name and develop retail clothing department stores in other locations.

The company also said Canal Jean plans to its expand its existing retail space in Soho in 1997 by 15,000 square feet. It currently uses 50,000 square feet in the 100,000 square foot building it occupies.
NMC said Canal Jean earned about $1 million on gross sales of about $16 million in fiscal 1996.
